prices.note: Open the source for the number. This file records where to look, not a sale price.

sources.name: Jawa
sources.detail: Used graphics cards and used whole PCs.

sources.name: PCPartPicker
sources.detail: New parts, a running total, and their compatibility notes.

parts.name: Graphics card
parts.look: 8 GB is the start for a small chat model. 12 GB is the calmer start for pictures.

parts.name: Memory
parts.look: Match DDR4 or DDR5 to the motherboard. 32 GB is the calmer chat desk.

parts.name: Boot SSD
parts.look: NVMe for the system. Check the slot. M.2 is only the shape.

builds.name: First desk
builds.for: School, the web, and older games.
builds.parts: 16 GB of memory, a 1 TB SSD, and either no extra card or a used 8 GB card.
builds.check: Match the socket and the memory type in the checker, then price the list on PCPartPicker.

builds.name: Chat at home
builds.parts: 32 GB of memory and a 12 GB card. One heavy job at a time.
builds.check: Price the card on Jawa if used, or PCPartPicker if new.

builds.name: Movie shelf
builds.parts: A small SSD for the system and CMR hard drives for the files.
builds.check: Read the disk datasheet for CMR. Do not buy a Purple drive for this.
